The package ships the .d.ts napi generates, not anything built from here. `isolatedModules` + `verbatimModuleSyntax` are what Vite, esbuild and swc imply, and they are what makes an ambient `const enum` in a .d.ts unusable — so the gate has to run with them on, or it would not catch the class of problem it exists for.
